status: exploratory; candidates screened on existing schedules before optimization; frozen here before new model optimization
normalization: Greedy-LPT per instance; cost reference recomputed for each model

models.label: 整批统一释放，连续秒租赁
models.adaptation: BaTS reservation-time multiplied by fleet-price structure; fixed 50 VMs, all leased at t=0 and released together at the observed batch makespan; continuous-time limit of reservation billing. This fleet policy and continuous-time specialization are our assumptions. No exact source formula or live tariff claim. Normalized cost equals normalized makespan exactly, so this duplicates that criterion.

models.label: 整批统一释放，按秒计费最低60秒
models.adaptation: Same fixed-fleet policy. ET2FA supplies the billing time rule, not the common-release policy. No startup, DAG, hibernation, storage or elastic VM count. At small task counts minimum billing can make all methods tie.

models.label: ERTH资源带宽加权完成时间（自定义适配）
models.adaptation: Hybrid uses the previously frozen ERTH resource-bandwidth ratio and FCFS completion time. Replacing execution time with completion time is our adaptation, not ERTH Eq.4. Resource bandwidth is an abstract CPU-memory resource measure, not a modeled network transfer charge.

selection: Largest minimum mean paired cost reduction over five competing metaheuristics on discovery; all candidates and prior six models disclosed. Freeze winner and discovery strongest opponent before fresh confirmation103-132. No algorithm, price, weight or seed tuning after selection.
inference: Seed-cluster (same seed across10 scales); 30000 percentile bootstrap replicates. Five metaheuristic pairwise seed-cluster Wilcoxon tests with Holm adjustment.
